The first slice — phase 1 (chart builder + saved views) — is currently feature-complete on staging behind the `dash_v2` flag, with query performance on very large workspaces and empty states still open [5].

Customers can try it when the design-partner beta opens **Wednesday Dec 9**, for 5 customers only: Orbitly, Zest Grocers, and three accounts from the October trial cohort [5][6]. Everyone else waits until general availability, targeted for late January (not committed) [5]. Note this is a later, firmer date than the original plan of "early December" in the spec [1] and the plan of feature-complete by Dec 4 [2].

Two caveats worth flagging: Pinecrest Logistics asked for beta access during their evaluation and Sam said he'd check [10], but the beta list is fixed at 5 [5][6]; and a waitlist opens in January for everyone else [6].
